notes.title: Beta Patch ahead!
notes.notes:
Dear TIMBER fans and players,

today we started a public Beta for Timber, foreshadowing the upcoming patch. This will include:

- Increased PhysX weight of the logs
- new postprocessing Pipeline based on mastereffects
- slightly increased "grace size" of machinery arms
. a new mountainview

You can access the beta via your steam client (Tab BETA in the games properties!) and all your savegames are compatible.

Please provide Feedback in our Steam Forum.

And while you are already here on Steam, please support us with your GL vote so we can go to MARS:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=814644485
